The Shop

A storefront built on trust

At FF39 Zibatex Building, opposite Dantata House in Kantin Kwari Market, Lah-Loh Fabrics & Couture has built a name on original quality — bales and yards alike, backed by a reputation customers already know across Kano.

Every fabric on the shelf is chosen the same way: sourced directly, checked personally, and ready for wholesale or retail the moment it arrives.

"Fashion as unique as you."
Sourced Globally, Trusted Locally

From the mill floor to the shelf in Kano

Direct relationships with mills abroad mean every bolt is checked at the source — not just resold, but personally sourced and verified before it reaches Kwari Market.

That reach is what lets Lah-Loh serve tailors and retailers across Kano, with delivery reaching Lagos and Abuja on request.
